verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Kimi help center listing "记忆" (memory) among its general features (search, memory, scheduled tasks, skills). That shows a first-party memory feature exists, but nothing describes how it works. The million-token context applies within a single session, not across chats, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documentation that memory carries context from previous chats into new conversations, details on what is remembered and how it is applied, user controls for viewing or editing memories, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant remember relevant context from previous chats and apply it in new conversations

citations.quote: 搜索、记忆、定时任务、技能等通用功能
